subject: Vertex Health MAP: hosting mode evaluation & close cadence
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@vertexhealth.com>, Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@vertexhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Vertex Health MAP: hosting mode evaluation & close cadence

Hi Samir / Olivia —

Thanks again for the time last week. Attached is version 1.3 of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that focuses on the hosting-mode evaluation (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and an initial close cadence we think is realistic given your compliance and procurement windows. High level:

- Goal: Decide hosting mode and go/no-go for PO by 2027-04-15.
- Quick eval sprint: 2 weeks (PoC traffic + latency and cost profiling).
- Security checks: SOC2 evidence + data residency verification in parallel (we can run evidence intake in 1–3 business days).

As requested, the MAP includes: acceptance criteria per mode (latency, throughput, data residency, audit logs retention), evaluation milestones, who owns each task, and a proposed pricing/cost delta matrix. I also attached a short cost estimate workbook and a zipped snapshot of evidence we commonly provide to customers for initial review.

Request: Can you confirm the procurement target date and whether AP/AR requires a specific EDI/PO flow? If so, loop in procurement and I’ll add the milestone into the MAP.

Next steps I propose this week:
- Wed: quick alignment sync (30m) to confirm region constraints + acceptance thresholds.
- Fri: hand off PoC instructions and pre-provisioned test keys for Hosted and Dedicated lanes.

Thanks — I’ll hold the doc for edits and can push an updated MAP after your feedback.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vertex Health MAP: hosting mode evaluation & close cadence

Neha —

Thanks for the MAP, looks comprehensive. Quick notes from our side:

- Procurement is targeting a PO by 2027-04-20 at the latest; we can try to pull that forward but need final SOW and pricing by 2027-04-05.
- Data residency: all PHI must remain in us-east-1 or on-prem (we cannot use eu regions).
- Security intake: procurement will need the SOC2 Type II report and answers to a 30-question vendor security questionnaire.

A couple of asks before the Wed sync:
1) Can you confirm whether the Dedicated lane supports hardware isolation and private networking to our VPC?
2) Rough ballpark: what is the expected monthly cost delta between Hosted (standard) and Dedicated (reserved pool) for our projected Q3 throughput? A spreadsheet is great; a short sanity-check number is helpful for the execs.

Looping in procurement (procurement@vertexhealth.com) for visibility and to start the questionnaire.

—Samir
Samir Patel
VP, Product Operations — Vertex Health
samir@vertexhealth.com
+1 (617) 555-3410

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vertex Health MAP: hosting mode evaluation & close cadence

Samir / team —

Quick technical reply with what we plan to run during the 2-week eval sprint:

Planned tests (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)
- Latency SLO validation: 95th percentile under 220ms for standard prompts (50–150 tokens).
- Throughput: sustained 1k reqs/min with autoscale burst for peak windows.
- KV cache behavior: prefix reuse scenarios from your ingestion patterns.
- Data residency & ingress/egress: confirm all logs and retention settings; Dedicated supports private VPC peering and HSM-backed KMS.
- Fallback policy: automatic fallback to smaller model variant when capacity constrained (we will measure quality delta).

Constraints / clarifications:
- Private on-prem deployment has a longer lead time (~8–12 weeks for on-prem packaging + validation) — if you need an on-prem option for PHI, Dedicated in us-east-1 with VPC peering is usually the faster path to satisfy auditors.
- Cost estimate: I’ll run a conservative delta and send the spreadsheet shortly; expect ~30–45% premium for reserved Dedicated capacity vs Hosted (depending on commitment term and quantization choices).

I’ll include a short test plan document by EOD that maps each MAP milestone to the specific artifact (logs, perf traces, acceptance checklist).

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@vertexhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@vertexhealth.com>, procurement@vertexhealth.com
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vertex Health MAP: hosting mode evaluation & close cadence

Thanks — this reads well. A few clarifying questions for the Wed 30m:

- Region: Confirming us-east-1 as the only allowed cloud region for PHI. If Dedicated requires any external peering, we need a diagram for our networking team.
- Cost: can you provide a back-of-envelope monthly delta per 100M tokens for Hosted vs Dedicated? That helps our finance folks assess runway.
- Timeline: procurement will aim for 2027-04-20 but Olivia & I prefer closing earlier if we can land the SOW by 2027-04-05.

Procurement has started the questionnaire — procurement@vertexhealth.com is filling the vendor security questionnaire and will send us the first pass by Friday.

—Olivia Turner
Head of Partnerships — Vertex Health

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@vertexhealth.com>, Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@vertexhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, procurement@vertexhealth.com
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vertex Health MAP: hosting mode evaluation & close cadence

Samir / Olivia / team —

Appreciate the quick reads and the procurement heads-up. Attached is an updated MAP snapshot (v1.4) with the following changes based on the thread:

- Region locked: us-east-1 only for PHI (milestone added).
- Dedicated lane: added explicit note re: VPC peering and HSM-backed KMS; Karthik will provide the network diagram by Tue.
- Timeline: added SOW target 2027-04-05 and PO target 2027-04-15 (we can update to 2027-04-20 if procurement needs slack).
- Eval plan: detailed test matrix (latency, throughput, KV cache reuse, fallback quality checks) and acceptance criteria per mode.
- Cost: initial back-of-envelope in the attached workbook; Karthik to refine delta per 100M tokens early next week.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Mon 03/29 10:00am ET — 30m sync to confirm network diagram recipients, acceptance thresholds, and finalize SOW deliverable list.
2) Tue 03/30 — we hand off PoC keys and test instructions for Hosted and Dedicated lanes.

If procurement wants to push the PO later than 04/15, please confirm and we will reflect that in the MAP. I’ll update v1.4 after Monday’s sync with any final notes and upload to the HubSpot deal.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
